As a Technical Support Officer, you will become part of a close-knit team, supporting customers with high-quality software solutions for the medical sector. You'll benefit from a comprehensive training programme and plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.
 

Your responsibilities as a Technical Support Officer:
 

As a Technical Support Officer, you are the first point of contact for customers who need technical assistance. You primarily support French-speaking customers, while also communicating regularly in English with colleagues and customers from other countries.

The Software & Services (SAS) Competence Centre is looking for a Application & Platform Security Architect to help shape the secure and sustainable digitalization of Vito. As our software landscape continues to grow, cybersecurity expectations in research and innovation projects increase, and regulations such as NIS2 become more important, we are looking for an expert who can develop an organization-wide architectural vision and translate it into practical guidelines, standards, and improvement initiatives. You will help research software evolve from prototypes into reliable operational solutions and support teams in integrating security, compliance, and best practices from the very start of their developments.

You will join a multidisciplinary team of around 30 software engineers, DevOps specialists, analysts, and project managers with a strong affinity for scientific research. Together, we bridge the gap between research and impact by developing digital solutions that make scientific insights accessible to industry, policymakers, and society.

Our expertise spans three main domains: application development, supporting researchers in building high-quality software, and providing scalable research platforms such as Kubernetes, cloud, and HPC environments. We combine software engineering, AI-assisted development, DevOps, cybersecurity, and data infrastructure to accelerate the transition from research to reliable operational solutions.

Within SAS, you will have the opportunity to work on challenges with real societal impact, collaborate with leading researchers, and contribute to an organization-wide culture of software engineering and innovation.
What will you do?

You will work closely with researchers, software engineers, DevOps specialists, and project teams to embed security by design into our digital solutions.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Assessing the current security posture of Vito's internally developed applications and defining a phased roadmap towards NIS2 compliance.

• 
Defining, implementing, and maintaining security standards, architectural guidelines, and software development best practices across the organization.

• 
Developing policy frameworks, guidelines, and reusable building blocks to integrate cybersecurity into research proposals and innovation projects from the outset.

• 
Reviewing application architectures and development processes across a diverse software landscape, and identifying improvement opportunities related to security, quality, maintainability, and operational maturity.

• 
Supporting and coaching development teams in adopting secure coding principles, modern CI/CD practices, and scalable architectural patterns.

• 
Promoting a consistent and future-oriented software engineering approach in which security, compliance, and quality are built in by default.

• 
Acting as a bridge between IT, software development, and research, ensuring that innovative solutions can safely evolve from prototypes into operational services.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to make an organization-wide impact on how digital solutions are designed, developed, and operated within a leading research organization.

• 
A Master's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

• 
At least 5 years of experience in software architecture, security architecture, application security, or a related field.

• 
Strong understanding of secure software development practices, application security principles, and modern software architectures.

• 
Experience with cloud-native technologies, container platforms (e.g. Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.

• 
Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks, standards, and regulations such as NIS2, ISO 27001, OWASP, or similar.

• 
Experience conducting architecture reviews, risk assessments, and translating security requirements into practical guidance for development teams.

• 
The ability to balance security, usability, innovation, and operational realities in a research-driven environment.

• 
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to collaborate effectively with researchers, developers, IT teams, and management.

• 
A proactive mindset with the ability to drive change and build consensus across diverse teams.

• 
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Dutch is considered an asset.

Nice to have:

• 
Experience in research, innovation, or R&D-driven environments.

• 
Knowledge of AI/ML platforms, data-intensive applications, or scientific software development.

• 
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, Togaf, Azure Security Engineer, or similar.

• 
Experience establishing security governance, secure development frameworks, or organization-wide security improvement programs.

Are you ready to make data trustworthy, well-managed and truly valuable across an organisation? As a Data Governance Senior Consultant at BDO, you will help organisations design and embed the frameworks, operating models and ways of working that keep data reliable, well-governed and fit for strategic and operational decision-making. Join a team that values expertise, client proximity and pragmatism, and contribute and lead high-impact data governance projects in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
What will you be doing?
In this role, you will act as a Data Governance expert across multiple projects and clients, designing and delivering all-round governance frameworks and operating models while helping teams grow their capabilities. Here’s what you’ll be doing:

• Collaborate with clients: Work closely with stakeholders to understand their data landscape, governance maturity, business requirements and strategic objectives
• Design governance frameworks & operating models: Develop and implement pragmatic, all-round data governance frameworks — policies, standards, roles and responsibilities, and operating models — tailored to each organisation’s needs and level of maturity.
• Establish roles & accountability: Define and embed data ownership and stewardship structures, decision rights and governance bodies (councils, forums) that make governance stick.
• Improve data quality & management: Set up frameworks for data quality, metadata, lineage and master data, translating governance principles into practical, day-to-day ways of working.
• Improve decision performance: Identify opportunities to optimise data management processes, performance management and the overall governance operating model.
• Support change and adoption: Coach and train stakeholders to ensure strong adoption, cultural buy-in and the long-term value of the governance frameworks you put in place.
• Leverage BDO’s network: Collaborate with colleagues across Finance, IT, Risk, Strategy and other practices to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions for clients.
• Coach and enable teams: Contribute actively to peer coaching, knowledge sharing and team enablement, and support the growth of colleagues by spreading expertise, mentoring on the job and strengthening data governance capabilities across the team.
What do you bring to the table?
We are looking for someone who combines strong analytical skills with a consulting mindset and a passion for well-managed data. You bring:

• Relevant experience: 5+ years of experience in Data Governance, Data Management or a closely related field, ideally within a consulting or project-based environment, with a track record of leading initiatives end to end.
• Educational background: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data, Engineering, Business Economics or a related field.
• Language proficiency: Fluent in either French or Dutch, with a very good knowledge of English.
• Governance expertise: Solid experience designing and implementing data governance frameworks and operating models. Covering roles and responsibilities, policies, standards, data quality, metadata and stewardship, in a tool-neutral, process- and framework-first way.
• Balanced technical & advisory profile: Comfortable moving between hands-on technical understanding with light implementation work (data models, data platforms, data quality and metadata concepts) and advisory work on operating models, policies and governance strategy.
• Scalable delivery: Proven interest or expertise in scaling governance delivery through reusable templates, accelerators, best practices and automation where relevant.
• Business understanding: Ability to translate business needs and governance principles into practical, value-driven and adoptable solutions.
• Communication & leadership: Excellent communication skills and the ability to interact with, and influence, both business and technical stakeholders up to senior level.
• Consulting skills: Strong problem-solving, project management and change management capabilities.
• Consulting exposure: Comfortable operating as a governance expert across several projects and clients in parallel, adapting quickly to different business contexts while maintaining quality and consistency.
• Motivation: A strong desire to help grow a data governance practice and actively contribute to its development.

jobs.occupation: Senior Technical Project Lead – Data Lifecycle Management
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Lead the implementation of the Data Retention Initiative to turn information policies into operational practice.
• Define and execute end-to-end Data Lifecycle Management plans across diverse business units and systems.

• Translate regulatory requirements such as GDPR and NIS 2 into actionable retention and deletion obligations.
• Implement classification and tagging strategies for security, privacy, and structured data identification.

• 8+ years of professional experience in IT, data management, or information governance within large organizations.
• 3+ years of specialized experience in data lifecycle management, records and retention, or archiving.
• Proven track record leading cross-functional delivery involving senior stakeholders in complex environments.
• Deep domain expertise in IMPs, retention schedules, legal hold, and archiving.
• Technical proficiency in scripting, integration, and archival jobs to drive deletion at scale.
• Experience with Microsoft Purview for retention and enforcement across M365.
• Working knowledge of regulatory drivers for data retention, specifically GDPR and NIS 2.
• Master’s degree in IT, Data Management, or a related field.
• Strong experience in stakeholder management and change leadership across decentralized organizations.

• Safeguard quality and compliance – Ensure new technologies are implemented in line with accounting standards, quality requirements and regulatory expectations.
What do you bring to the table?
Your foundation:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Accounting, Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent
• 2–5 years of experience within accounting or strong affinity with accounting processes (experience in relevant tech roles is also valued)
• Hands-on experience with data analytics, BI tools, RPA, workflow automation or ML/AI proofs of concept
• Ability to build prototypes or drive R&D initiatives based on structured requirement lists
• Strong stakeholder management skills: you translate business challenges into practical technical solutions

Your personality:

Ready to combine your audit expertise with innovation and methodology? Perfect timing! We’re looking for a Technical Specialist – Audit & Assurance Technology & Standards.

If you enjoy translating complex audit standards into practical tools, improving the way auditors work, and collaborating on technology-driven improvements within audit, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a real impact.

You’ll act as the operational link between our Audit & Assurance Tech & Innovation Committee and the Technical (A&A Compliance) team, ensuring that new technologies, evolving standards and audit methodology move forward together.

Forget static methodologies that gather dust. You keep our audit approach sharp, practical and future-proof.

• Translate evolving standards into practice – Monitor new audit standards, regulatory updates and guidance from the BDO network. You analyse the impact and convert these developments into concrete updates for methodology, templates and guidance used by our audit teams.
• Develop practitioner-friendly tools – Revise and maintain audit templates, checklists and guidance. You ensure they remain compliant, user-friendly and efficient, striking the right balance between innovation, quality and practicality.
• Bridge innovation and compliance – Work closely with the Innovation Officer within Audit & Assurance to assess new audit tools and technologies. You provide compliance input, methodology requirements and risk assessments to ensure new solutions truly support the audit process.

• Support pilots and implementations – Analyse the impact of new tools or methodology updates, help coordinate pilot projects and identify training or change management needs for our audit teams.
• Communicate changes clearly – Produce concise guidance, change logs and practitioner updates whenever templates, processes or standards evolve.
• Ensure consistency across technical initiatives – Work closely with other technical specialists to maintain alignment and quality across the different components of our audit methodology.
What do you bring to the table?
Your foundation:

• Minimum 5 years of experience in audit (Big Four, national firm or similar environment)
• Strong interest in audit standards, methodology and compliance
• Affinity with technology and experience with digital audit tools or data analytics
• Advanced Excel skills (formulas, pivot tables, Power Query / Power Pivot; basic VBA is a plus)
• Experience with SharePoint or similar document management systems
• Experience developing templates, guidance documents or policy updates
• Professional qualification such as CPA, CA or CIA is a plus but not required
• Fluency in English; Dutch or French is an asset
 

Your personality:

• You combine a strong compliance mindset with curiosity for new technologies
• You are structured and detail-oriented, with strong version control and documentation discipline
• You work independently and proactively, while collaborating smoothly with colleagues across teams

jobs.occupation: ESG & Impact Officer - International Exposure - Brussels
jobs.description:
The hiring company is a medium-sized organization within the financial services sector, specializing in banking and financial services. It is known for its focus on innovation, sustainability, and delivering impactful solutions for its stakeholders

Jobomschrijving

As an ESG & Impact Officer your responsibilities are:

• Conduct ESG and impact due diligence for high-risk investments
• Assess projects across sectors such as infrastructure, mining, agriculture, forestry, and financial services
• Manage external ESG and environmental & social consultants
• Support portfolio companies in implementing ESG management systems and action plans
• Monitor ESG performance and impact outcomes throughout the investment lifecycle
• Strengthen ESG policies, frameworks, tools, and internal processes
• Contribute to impact reporting, case studies, and stakeholder communications
• Coordinate third-party ESG and impact assessments
• Represent the organization at industry events and ESG-related initiatives

A successful ESG & Impact Officer should have:

• Master's degree in Economics, International Development, Political Science, Environmental Sciences, or a related discipline
• Strong experience applying IFC Performance Standards
• Direct contacts with companies
• Exposure to projects in emerging and developing markets
• Solid knowledge of ESG risk assessment methodologies
• Experience reviewing Environmental & Social Management Systems (ESMS)
• Understanding of impact measurement frameworks, SDGs, Theory of Change, or similar approaches
• Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; Power BI experience is a plus
• Ability to draft high-quality analytical reports and investment documentation in English
